goal: Implement Room v3, migration, versioned protocol, local/search/sync repositories, and transactional deletion against the frozen hybrid domain contracts.
non_goals: Do not modify Compose or feature UI.
Do not modify Python services or provider runtime.
Do not change frozen shared contract signatures without controller approval.
Do not revert unrelated user or worker changes.
acceptance_criteria: Old LlmProfile rows migrate to one connection and one model binding without losing session selection.
Multiple active TurnRuns in one session remain valid.
Local syncable writes and Outbox records are transactional.
Session deletion writes a tombstone and removes session-owned records.
Secrets and sync internals are excluded from export.
verification_expectations: Run protocol and core:data JVM tests.
Compile Android migration tests and run them when a device is available.
Validate exported Room schema and protocol fixtures.
